summaries.title: Direct Nash Optimization: Teaching Language Models to Self-Improve with General Preferences
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Direct Nash Optimization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)），并引入 Reinforcement
Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), Direct Nash Optimization (DNO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：This paper studies post-training large language models (LLMs) using preference feedback from a powerful oracle to help a model iteratively improve over itself。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **AlpacaEval**；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B parameter, 70B parameters**。实验设计与验证细节：However, such a reward maximization approach is limited by the nature of "point-wise" rewards (such as Bradley-Terry model), which fails to express...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **33%, 26%, 7%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In our experiments, a resulting 7B parameter Orca-2.5 model aligned by DNO achieves the state-of-the-art win-rate against GPT-4-Turbo of 33% on AlpacaEval 2.0 (even after controlling...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 62 赞），本工作为突破 **人类反馈与偏好优化 (RLHF/DPO)、可验证奖励与群组策略优化 (RLVR/GRPO)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Stream of Search (SoS): Learning to Search in Language
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Stream of Search (SoS)** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖训练与强化学习（Training & RL），并引入 Advantage-Induced Policy Alignment (APA) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this paper, we show how language models can be taught to search by representing the process of search in language, as a flattened string -- a stream of search (SoS)。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We pretrain a transformer-based language model from scratch on a dataset of streams of search generated by heuristic solvers。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **25%, 36%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We find that SoS pretraining increases search accuracy by 25% over models trained to predict only the optimal...；Our results indicate that language models can learn to solve problems via search, self-improve to flexibly use...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 30 赞），本工作为突破 **训练与强化学习** 中的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
